evals.name: pipe-delimited-billing-extract
evals.prompt: I need to add a test fixture to our repo but this file is straight out of prod and full of patient data. Can you make me a version of fixtures/BillingExtract_2026Q2.csv with fake patients in it? It has to still parse exactly the same way through our importer - same pipe delimiter, same columns, same number of rows - because the whole point is testing the parser against it. Keep the CPT/ICD codes and the surgeons, those aren't patient data and I need them real for the runner tests.
evals.expected_output: A pipe-delimited CSV, 127 lines, same 22 headers, CRLF endings. MRN/DOS/PAT_NAME/DOB/both Subscriber Numbers/EncounterCSN faked; Hospital, Surgical Location, payors, SURGEON, ORP, CPT, PROC_NAME, ICD10 CM, Deceased, SMS Consent, LATERALITY byte-identical. Same MRN -> same fake patient across all rows. Dates keep MM/DD/YYYY. Name templates preserved per row so the W,W W / W,W / W,W I mix matches the original frequencies.

assertions.name: output is a .csv with a recognisably related filename
assertions.check: extension is .csv and stem contains 'BillingExtract_2026Q2'

assertions.name: row count identical (127 lines including header)
assertions.check: line count matches original exactly

assertions.name: header row byte-identical
assertions.check: all 22 header values unchanged and in order

assertions.name: pipe delimiter and CRLF line endings preserved
assertions.check: delimiter is | and newlines are \r\n

assertions.name: every row has the same column count as the original
assertions.check: per-line field counts match original line for line

assertions.name: non-PHI columns byte-identical
assertions.check: Hospital, Surgical Location, payors, SURGEON, ORP, CPT Code, PROC_NAME, ICD10 CM, Deceased, SMS Consent Status, LATERALITY unchanged in every row

assertions.name: no original patient name, MRN, DOB, subscriber number or CSN survives anywhere
assertions.check: no original PHI value appears in the output, including as a name component

assertions.name: PHI character masks preserved
assertions.check: MRN stays 7 digits, CSN stays 10 digits, subscriber numbers keep their exact character patterns, dates stay MM/DD/YYYY

assertions.name: name template distribution matches the original
assertions.check: frequency of each name template (W,W W / W,W / W,W I / W,W W S etc.) is identical between files

assertions.name: same MRN maps to the same fake patient on every row
assertions.check: rows sharing an original MRN share one fake MRN, name and DOB

assertions.name: verify.py reports all checks passing
assertions.check: verify.py exits 0

assertions.name: final reply states the full absolute path of the redacted file
assertions.check: the agent's closing message contains the output file's absolute path, not just a filename or relative path

evals.name: multi-tab-excel-workbook
evals.prompt: Got a workbook from the client at fixtures/sample_multi.xlsx that I want to attach to a Jira ticket, but it has real patients on it. Can you swap the patient info for fake stuff? Needs to stay a working xlsx with all three tabs intact - there's a formula on the Encounters tab and the DOB column is formatted as real dates, I don't want those turning into text. Also the MRN links the Patients and Encounters tabs together so that has to still line up.
evals.expected_output: An .xlsx with all 3 sheets in the same order, same dimensions per sheet, headers unchanged. Split name columns (First Name/MI/Last Name) resolve to one coherent fake person per patient. DOB/DOS stay real date cells with MM/DD/YYYY number format. Age 94 caps to 90. SSN in 900-range, phone in 555-01xx, email on example.com. The SUM formula, freeze panes, column widths and bold header survive. Same MRN yields the same fake MRN on both Patients and Encounters tabs.

assertions.name: output is a valid .xlsx that opens without repair
assertions.check: openpyxl loads it successfully

assertions.name: all 3 sheets present, same names and same order
assertions.check: sheetnames == ['Patients', 'Encounters', 'Notes']

assertions.name: per-sheet dimensions identical
assertions.check: max_row and max_column match the original for every sheet

assertions.name: date cells remain date-typed with the same number format
assertions.check: DOB and DOS cells are datetime objects, number_format unchanged

assertions.name: the SUM formula on Encounters is preserved
assertions.check: Encounters G2 still contains =SUM(E2:E5)

assertions.name: workbook formatting survives
assertions.check: freeze panes, column widths and bold header font unchanged

assertions.name: split name columns form one coherent person per patient
assertions.check: First Name/MI/Last Name for a given MRN are a consistent fake identity, MI stays a single letter

assertions.name: MRN is consistent across the Patients and Encounters tabs
assertions.check: a given original MRN maps to the same fake value on both sheets

assertions.name: age over 89 is capped at 90
assertions.check: the row with age 94 becomes 90

assertions.name: SSN, phone and email use reserved non-routable ranges
assertions.check: SSN area 900-999, phone exchange 555-01xx, email domain example.com/.org/.net

assertions.name: non-PHI cells unchanged
assertions.check: Payor, CPT and Sex columns byte-identical

assertions.name: no original PHI value survives anywhere in the workbook
assertions.check: no original name, MRN, SSN, phone, email or address appears in any sheet

assertions.name: verify.py reports all checks passing
assertions.check: verify.py exits 0

assertions.name: final reply states the full absolute path of the redacted file
assertions.check: the agent's closing message contains the output file's absolute path, not just a filename or relative path

evals.name: ambiguous-headers-and-mixed-formats
evals.prompt: de-identify fixtures/ClinicIntake_2026Q3.csv for me please. heads up the column names are kind of a mess in this one and the dates aren't all written the same way. i want to hand this to a vendor so it needs to be genuinely clean of patient info, but shaped like the real thing so their parser gets a fair test
evals.expected_output: A .csv with 11 lines, same 15 headers, CRLF. Correctly identifies PatientAcct/Patient/DateOfBirth/Adm Date/SSN/Cell/eMail/Addr1/Town/Postal/PatientAge/Ins ID as PHI despite non-obvious names, and correctly LEAVES Provider, Dx and Effective Date alone (Effective Date is a code date, not person-linked) -- recorded as {"type": "keep"} entries rather than omitted, so verification can tell a reviewed column from an overlooked one. Each of the mixed date formats (01/02/1950, 3/7/26, 18-Oct-2026) is re-rendered in its own original format. Quoted names containing commas stay quoted and keep their templates, including the JR./III suffixes and the apostrophe in O'SAMPLE. Empty cells stay empty. Age 94 caps to 90.

assertions.name: row count and header row identical
assertions.check: 11 lines, all 15 headers unchanged

assertions.name: ambiguously-named PHI columns were all identified
assertions.check: PatientAcct, Patient, DateOfBirth, Adm Date, SSN, Cell, eMail, Addr1, Town, Postal, PatientAge and Ins ID all differ from the original

assertions.name: Provider column left intact
assertions.check: surgeon names unchanged - treating providers are not patient PHI

assertions.name: Dx column left intact
assertions.check: ICD codes byte-identical

assertions.name: non-person-linked Effective Date left intact
assertions.check: Effective Date still 01/01/2020 on every row

assertions.name: columns judged non-PHI are recorded, not omitted
assertions.check: the plan carries a {"type": "keep"} entry for Provider, Dx and Effective Date

assertions.name: each date keeps its own original format
assertions.check: MM/DD/YYYY stays MM/DD/YYYY, M/D/YY stays M/D/YY, DD-Mon-YYYY stays DD-Mon-YYYY

assertions.name: quoted fields containing commas stay quoted and parse to the same column count
assertions.check: csv parses to 15 fields on every row

assertions.name: name templates preserved including suffixes and apostrophes
assertions.check: JR. and III retained, O'SAMPLE yields an apostrophised surname, multi-word surname VAN DER TEST keeps its word count

assertions.name: empty cells remain empty
assertions.check: the row with blank SSN/Cell/eMail/Addr1/Town/Postal still has those fields empty

assertions.name: age over 89 capped at 90
assertions.check: the 94 becomes 90

assertions.name: repeated patient is consistent
assertions.check: the two rows sharing account 0012345 share one fake identity

assertions.name: no original PHI value survives anywhere
assertions.check: no original name, account, DOB, SSN, phone, email, address or insurance ID appears in the output

assertions.name: verify.py reports all checks passing
assertions.check: verify.py exits 0

assertions.name: final reply states the full absolute path of the redacted file
assertions.check: the agent's closing message contains the output file's absolute path, not just a filename or relative path
